en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 in morning trade
en.dek: The benchmark opened at 24,985, down 289 points or 1.15 per cent, the first break of that level in nearly six weeks, RTHK reported.
body: Hong Kong stocks opened below the 25,000-point mark on Thursday morning, the first time the Hang Seng Index has traded through that level in nearly one and a half months, RTHK reported.

In the pre-open auction the index was quoted at 24,985, down 289 points or 1.15 per cent. The Hang Seng Tech Index was 61 points, or 1.39 per cent, lower at 4,359. Local media later put the benchmark around 24,913, down 361 points, with the China Enterprises Index and technology stocks also weaker and morning turnover near HK$13 billion.

Large mainland technology names and local financial counters were among the decliners cited in early coverage. The market had closed on Wednesday at 25,274.96, down 0.17 per cent. Trading continues through the afternoon session.

zh.headline: 恒指早市失守二萬五千關 近一個半月首見
zh.dek: 恒生指數競價時段報24,985點，跌289點或1.15%，港台報道這是近一個半月首次跌穿25,000點。
body: 港股周四早市跌穿25,000點關口。港台報道，恒生指數競價時段報24,985點，跌289點，跌幅1.15%，是近一個半月以來首次失守該水平。
同一時段恒生科技指數報4,359點，跌61點或1.39%。其後本地媒體引述早段報價，恒指低見約724,913點，跌361點；國企指數及科技股同步偏軟，早市成交約130億元。
報道指大型科技股及金融股帶領下跌。恒指周三收市報25,274.96點，跌0.17%。下午持續交易，收市數字仍待公布。
